name: registry-leanpool
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,runpy
p=Path.cwd()
plan={"url":"https://github.com/LeanPool/lean-pool","destination":"sources/registry-leanpool.html","source_identity":"Current LeanPool public proof registry root","purpose":"Bounded current registry metadata screen for all twenty exact routes","routes":[]}
plan['routes']=[str(i) for i in json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']]
z=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'registry-leanpool.plan.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(runpy.run_path(str(p/'source_get_guard.py'))['Guard'](p).fetch(plan))
